name: Pumpkin
author: krevan76@users.noreply.github.com
description: Pumpkin is a Minecraft server built entirely in Rust, offering a fast, efficient, and customizable experience.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -e

apk add --no-cache curl

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

ARCH=$(uname -m)
case "$ARCH" in
    x86_64|amd64)
        PUMPKIN_ARCH="X64"
        ;;
    aarch64|arm64)
        PUMPKIN_ARCH="ARM64"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

BINARY_NAME="pumpkin-${PUMPKIN_ARCH}-Linux-musl"

if [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ "${VERSION}" = "nightly" ]; then
    URL="https://github.com/Pumpkin-MC/Pumpkin/releases/download/nightly/${BINARY_NAME}"
else
    URL="https://github.com/Pumpkin-MC/Pumpkin/releases/download/${VERSION}/${BINARY_NAME}"
fi

echo "Downloading Pumpkin from: $URL"
curl -fsSL "$URL" -o /mnt/server/pumpkin
chmod +x /mnt/server/pumpkin

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/pumpkin.toml ]; then
    timeout 2 ./pumpkin || true
fi

variables.name: Rust backtrace
variables.description:
"0" -> No backtrace is generated. This is the default behavior.
"1" -> Generates a minimal backtrace showing only relevant information about where the panic occurred.
"full" -> Generates a detailed backtrace, showing all frames leading up to the panic, including functions in the Rust standard library and dependencies.

variables.name: Pumpkin Version
variables.description: The version of Pumpkin to install. Options: 'nightly', 'latest', or a specific release tag (e.g. 'v0.1.0').
